brand.name: Sunspel
brand.whyThisBrand: Best live match for a Fruma fabric-intelligence demo: a mill-and-brand story where the hero polo exists because they rejected dense piqué. In 1955 Peter Hill found piqué polos too hot on the French Riviera, went back to Long Eaton, and revived lacemaking machines to knit Q75 cotton warp-knit mesh (from earlier Q14 cellular cotton). The same style was later slimmed for Daniel Craig in Casino Royale. Own-site copy still says the refined collar holds its own under a jumper or jacket. Made in Portugal from extra-long staple California Supima cotton. Live UK/EU listings of the same style code MPOL1026 show exactly the mapping problems Fruma is for: mesh sold as piqué, slim sold as regular, Navy sold as Blue, Charcoal tagged Grey, titles truncated or misspelled, sale prices vs £140 RRP.
brand.notOrganicGots: Sunspel markets traceable, sustainably farmed Supima — not GOTS organic. Use that gap in the demo: retailers still need a cert field even when the brand story is traceability rather than organic.
brand.idealRetailerPattern: Preference was own-site + John Lewis + Mr Porter. On 2026-08-25 John Lewis brand page is empty (no SKUs) and no live Mr Porter product URL for this polo was found. Substituted live equivalent UK/EU destinations: Liberty, END., Selfridges, Farfetch, Harrods, plus gravitypope (CA).

hero.name: Riviera Polo Shirt
hero.composition: 100% extra-long staple Supima cotton, traceable to a single farm in California
hero.structure: In-house Q75 cotton warp-knit mesh (not piqué). Designed as a cooler alternative to dense piqué. Spread collar, button placket, chest patch pocket, slim fit. Made in Portugal.
hero.weight: Lightweight mesh. Shopify shipping weight 150g. Fabric GSM is not published on the product page.
hero.care: Gentle wash at 30°C with similar colours. Do not tumble dry. Dry cleanable.
hero.description: Developed in the 1950s for warm days on the French Riviera, the Riviera Polo is one of Sunspel’s most recognisable styles. Made from a lightweight mesh cotton developed in-house, it is breathable, comfortable and cut with a slim, modern silhouette. The style was later adapted for Daniel Craig’s first appearance as James Bond in Casino Royale, and it remains a key piece in the collection today.
hero.longCopyExcerpt: The refined collar ensures it will hold its own under a jumper or even a jacket.
